newsitem.title: USA: The Hartford Q1 oper shr rises. [CORRECTED 16:25 GMT]
newsitem.headline: The Hartford Q1 oper shr rises. [CORRECTED 16:25 GMT]

text.p: (All Data Above 000s Except Per Share Numbers)
NOTE: First Call consensus estimate was $1.49 a share.
Operating income excludes net realized gains.
Including net realized gains, Q1 net income was $204 million, or $1.73 a share compared with $96 million or $0.82 a share a year ago.
Excluding net realized gains and catastrophe losses, core operating income was $195 million or $1.66 per share in the first quarter compared with $161 million, or $1.37 a share a year ago.
Catastrophe losses for the North American property- casualty operations were $16 million after tax (corrects from $6 million) compared with $77 milion a year ago.
Net realized capital gains were $25 million after tax compared with $12 million a year ago.
North American property-casualty revenues rose three percent in the first quarter to $1.605 billion and net income rose 17 percent to $120 million, excluding catastrophes.
International revenue rose eight percent to $417 million, but net income fell 33 percent to $14 million.
Life insurance revenues fell 20 percent to $996 million.
Excluding the Corporate Owned Life Insurance, which was adversely affected by recent changes in tax legislation, life revenues rose 17 percent.
Life insurance net income rose 15 percent to $62 million.
